The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.name: reborn-untested-town-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-19: the owner asked for more runs, "runs with untested parameters" among them. A pilot screen (RULES 16); the arms worth following into tiers are chosen at the gate with the owner. Dispatch is the owner's call.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-19, before any result of these profiles was read. Pilot screen (RULES 16): direction only, no claim.
borg.txt's own impact (games of 6 that change): risk 2000: 6; power_scale 80000: 5; w_attack 200: 6;
w_support 100: 6; w_space 50: 6; home_discount 1000: 6. None was ever changed on a borg-reborn-rs specimen.
Gate:
- no config_error; one binary; each arm's value in its written borg.txt (and in the effective settings the cell records);
- every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified and key outliers listed;
- death bundles reproduced;
- ctl writes nothing, so it should replay reborn-errands-main-pilot's none arm (the same specimen and starts) in
  18 of 18 games.
Report per arm and per class: games identical to ctl; deaths and causes, CL1-3 deaths, mean max CL and DL; paired
rescued and newly killed; town purchases that change (the planner's bought items per visit). Each arm is reported
as harmful, neutral or helpful (RULES 18), direction only.
Follow-up rule, fixed now: an arm goes to the small tier if it changes at least 3 of 18 games and is not behind ctl
on deaths by 2 or more, or if it is ahead of ctl on deaths or mean max CL; an arm that changes no game is inert and
dropped. The owner decides which arms go on.
